## Team Visualizations

```{=html}
<!-- Each teammate: agree as a team on who's making which plot before anyone starts, so
     no two people create the same visualization. Then add your own section below with
     your name and your one plot. -->
```

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

### \[Mahit Cherku\] — \[Distribution of Penguin Body Mass\]

```{r}
penguins |>
  filter(!is.na(body_mass_g)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = body_mass_g)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 250,
    fill = "steelblue",
    color = "white",
    boundary = 0
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Penguin Body Mass",
    x = "Body mass (g)",
    y = "Number of penguins"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Kelly Xiong - Bill Length vs FLipper Length

```{r}
glimpse(penguins)
ggplot(data = penguins, mapping = aes(x=flipper_length_mm, y=bill_length_mm)) + 
  geom_point(mapping = aes(color=species, shape=species)) + 
  geom_smooth(method="lm") + 
  labs(title="Bill Length and Flipper Length", 
       subtitle="Dimensions for Adelie, Chinstrap, and Gentoo Penguins" , 
       x= "Flipper Length (mm)", 
       y= "Bill Length (mm)", 
       color = "Species", 
       shape = "Species")
```

### Cooper Maberry — Bill Length and Body Mass Compared by Species

```{r}
penguinsdt |> 
ggplot(aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = body_mass_g, color = species)) +
     geom_point() +
     labs(
          title = "Bill Length and Body Mass Compared by Species",
          x = "Bill Length (mm)",
          y = "Body Mass (g)")
```

### Shayon Chakraborti — Body Mass by Species

```{r}
ggplot(data = penguins, mapping = aes(x = species, y = body_mass_g, fill = species)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Body Mass by Species",
       x = "Species",
       y = "Body Mass (g)",
       fill = "Species")
```

## Aashna Mishra — Bar Plot of Penguin Islands and Species

```{r}
ggplot(penguins, aes(x = island, fill = species)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Penguin Count by Island and Species",
       x = "Island", y = "Count")


```
